steps.title: Non-text Content
steps.how: Images, icons, SVGs and controls have a text alternative. Whether each alternative is meaningful is judged by a person.

steps.title: Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded)
steps.how: The UI contains no audio or video.

steps.title: Captions (Prerecorded)
steps.how: The UI contains no audio or video.

steps.title: Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
steps.how: The UI contains no audio or video.

steps.title: Captions (Live)
steps.how: The UI contains no audio or video.

steps.title: Audio Description (Prerecorded)
steps.how: The UI contains no audio or video.

steps.title: Info and Relationships
steps.how: ARIA, lists, tables, form labels, landmarks and heading levels are checked. Whether the structure matches the visual meaning is judged by a person.

steps.title: Meaningful Sequence
steps.how: The reading order is compared with the visual order. Whether the order makes sense is judged by a person.

steps.title: Sensory Characteristics
steps.how: Texts are searched for instructions that rely on shape, position or colour alone. A person reviews the hits.

steps.title: Orientation
steps.how: Every page works in portrait and landscape phone sizes and does not lock the orientation.

steps.title: Identify Input Purpose
steps.how: Fields that ask for data about the user carry a valid autocomplete token.

steps.title: Use of Color
steps.how: Links in text are distinguishable without colour. Whether colour alone carries other information is judged by a person.

steps.title: Audio Control
steps.how: The UI plays no audio.

steps.title: Contrast (Minimum)
steps.how: Text contrast is measured on every page, in every language, in the light and the dark theme.

steps.title: Resize Text
steps.how: At 200 % zoom nothing scrolls sideways or is cut off, in every language.

steps.title: Images of Text
steps.how: Images, canvases and CSS background images are checked for text rendered as pixels.

steps.title: Reflow
steps.how: At 320 CSS px width the page needs no horizontal scrolling and loses no content, in every language.

steps.title: Non-text Contrast
steps.how: Form control borders and focus indicators reach 3:1. Charts and icons are judged by a person.

steps.title: Text Spacing
steps.how: The WCAG text spacing values are applied and no content is cut off.

steps.title: Content on Hover or Focus
steps.how: Tooltips and popups appear on focus, close with Escape and stay while the pointer is on them.

steps.title: Keyboard
steps.how: Every control is reached with the Tab key; popups, dialogs and tabs work with the keyboard.

steps.title: No Keyboard Trap
steps.how: Tabbing through the page always leaves it again.

steps.title: Character Key Shortcuts
steps.how: Single printable keys pressed on the page trigger no action.

steps.title: Timing Adjustable
steps.how: No page refreshes, redirects or expires on its own while the user is reading.

steps.title: Pause, Stop, Hide
steps.how: Nothing moves, blinks or updates endlessly on an idle page, and reduced motion is respected.

steps.title: Three Flashes or Below Threshold
steps.how: The page is recorded over time; nothing flashes more than three times per second.

steps.title: Bypass Blocks
steps.how: Every page has landmarks and a skip link to the main content.

steps.title: Page Titled
steps.how: Every page has its own title, translated into every language.

steps.title: Focus Order
steps.how: Nothing hidden takes focus and no positive tabindex is used. Whether the order is logical is judged by a person.

steps.title: Link Purpose (In Context)
steps.how: Every link has an accessible name. Whether it describes the target is judged by a person.

steps.title: Multiple Ways
steps.how: Every page is linked from the navigation of every page. Further ways are judged by a person.

steps.title: Headings and Labels
steps.how: Headings and labels exist and are not empty. Whether they are descriptive is judged by a person.

steps.title: Focus Visible
steps.how: Every Tab stop looks different with and without focus, in the light and the dark theme.

steps.title: Pointer Gestures
steps.how: No control needs a multipoint or path-based gesture; a single click is enough.

steps.title: Pointer Cancellation
steps.how: Controls act when the pointer is released, not when it is pressed, so an action can be aborted.

steps.title: Label in Name
steps.how: The visible label of every control is part of its accessible name.

steps.title: Motion Actuation
steps.how: The page does not react to device motion or orientation events.

steps.title: Language of Page
steps.how: The lang attribute of the page names the language shown, on load and after switching language.

steps.title: Language of Parts
steps.how: Text in another language than the page is marked with its own lang attribute.

steps.title: On Focus
steps.how: Moving the focus never navigates, opens a window or otherwise changes the context.

steps.title: On Input
steps.how: Changing a field or a selection does not navigate or change the context unexpectedly.

steps.title: Consistent Navigation
steps.how: The navigation is the same, in the same order, on every page.

steps.title: Consistent Identification
steps.how: Controls with the same function have the same name on every page.

steps.title: Error Identification
steps.how: Submitting empty or invalid forms marks the fields and links a visible message in the page language. Whether the message is clear is judged by a person.

steps.title: Labels or Instructions
steps.how: Every field has a label. Whether the instructions are sufficient is judged by a person.

steps.title: Error Suggestion
steps.how: Error messages are present and translated. Whether they suggest a fix is judged by a person.

steps.title: Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)
steps.how: Deleting stored data asks for confirmation or can be undone.

steps.title: Parsing
steps.how: IDs are unique and the markup has no parsing errors that affect assistive technology.

steps.title: Name, Role, Value
steps.how: Every control has a name, a valid role and the states it needs.

steps.title: Status Messages
steps.how: Status areas are live regions. Whether each status change is announced is judged by a person.
